correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier/Bernoulli correlation identity for coprime frequency pairs and odd/odd versus mixed parity was reconstructed. Uniform 8r^2-Q(r)>=1/32 for r in [1/6,1/5] together with B(x)-B(y)>=-1/4 excludes ALL pairs with odd/odd ab>=16 and mixed parity ab>=4. Precisely nine small coprime pairs remain; their exact rational differences at 1/6,3/16,1/5 are nonnegative, with no other relevant interior branches. Independent exact-fraction rechecks of nine exceptions and 1004 radii confirm two candidate affine formulas and crosspoint. This is an all-frequency analytic proof, not bounded-frequency extrapolation.
